name: Ramon Gomez
biography: is a Security Professional working for a cloud hosting provider. He has been working in correlation theory for the last 8 years, including time spent working at a prominent North American vendor of SEIM software, providing theory and logic to improve the correlation capabilities of the product. His primary areas of professional expertise are in correlation theory, and Intrusion Detection/Analysis.
